clips.title: The story
paras: Within Darnassus, Priestess Alathea guides night elf priests in the Temple of the Moon. Devoted to Elune, she teaches sacred rites and helps acolytes prepare for healing, protection, and celestial magic.

Priestess Alathea teaches and guides the Sisterhood of Elune within Darnassus's Temple of the Moon. After leaving Shadowglen, night elf initiates come to the temple to deepen their bond with the Goddess. Alathea shares sacred knowledge with those who devote themselves to healing, protection, and divine light.

Night elf priests draw on Elune's grace, while human and dwarven priests follow the traditions of the Holy Light. Alathea teaches night elf blessings such as Stars of Elune and Elune's Grace. Under her guidance, acolytes learn to shape starlight into swift, protective shields against the dangers facing Kalimdor.
